name: Los Feliz Spanish house
facts: 1924 Spanish-style house in white stucco with flat roofs edged in red clay tile
Corner lot on Griffith Park Boulevard and Wood Terrace, with the ground rising toward the back
Black-framed glass garage door at street level under a bedroom, with a short driveway and the house number above it
Stairs beside the garage up to a side entry under a black metal awning
Red front door up a flight of concrete steps, with black-framed windows and a tile-topped hood over the bedroom window
Black French doors from the kitchen onto a patterned black-and-white tile landing with terracotta pots and wall lights
Brick-paver patio with a sofa, coffee table, dining table and a wall fountain in the bed by the house
Stucco garage building at the back of the lot with a red door facing the patio
Tall horizontal wood fence, raised brick planters, cactus, agave, yucca, bougainvillea and big shade trees
assumed: Windows on the back of the bedroom wing and on the Wood Terrace side aren't fully shown, so their places are guesses. The back garage building's door onto the side lane comes from the floor plan label. The skylight and roof vents are read from the overhead view, so their exact spots are guesses. The yucca and bougainvillea are shown as an agave and coral flowering shrubs, and the big trees are drawn smaller so they clear the house. The small black awning over the red front door was added on request. The tall green hedge topped with bushes along the back and side fences was added on request, standing in for the climbing vines and greenery there, and the fence was made taller to match the photos.
